messages:
sam: FYI saw multiple customers lodge tickets where UI showed "service outage" because they got 503s during quota/backpressure events. They kept retrying which amplified the spike.
rita: Ugh. 503 means platform/downstream in most client libs. We should avoid overloading that semantic.
omar: Historically the routing layer returned 503 when no compatible replica found; quota checks later return 429. The end result: same customer experience but different root cause.
claire: From console/product POV we need a single signal surface so dashboards and alerts map unambiguously. Right now our dashboards just show 5xx vs 4xx and that hides the pattern.
sam: Proposal sketch: canonicalize HTTP surface as follows:
- 429: quota / rate limiting (client-facing)
- 503: platform/unexpected infra failure only
- 200 + body.warning: soft-degrade (fall back to cheaper model)
Also always include machine headers: `X-RW-ErrKind`, `X-RW-ErrID`, `Retry-After` when applicable.
rita: I like canonicalization. Headers help partners who can't change reliance on status codes immediately. Suggest header names: `X-RW-ErrKind: quota_soft|quota_hard|routing_no_replica|model_unavailable` and `X-RW-ErrID: <short-hash>`.
omar: Telemetry ask: span/resource tags must include origin=(routing|quota|model), err_kind, err_id. We'll need a migration for existing dashboards.
claire: Console: we can display a compact badge derived from err_kind and a hover panel with human-friendly copy and next steps. Example mapping:
- quota_soft -> badge: "degraded"; tooltip: "Responses may be reduced quality due to load. Consider caching or batching."
- quota_hard -> badge: "quota reached"; tooltip: "Upgrade or request quota increase."
- routing_no_replica -> badge: "fallback"; tooltip: "Serving pool lacks a replica for this config; retry or try a compatible model."
sam: About the 200-with-warning approach: some SDKs mirror HTTP success and don't surface a warning body to callers. We need guidance: SDKs should expose a `degraded` flag and pass headers through.
omar: SDKs: add early parsing for RW headers and an opt-in strict-mode that treats `err_kind` as authoritative. Canary via feature flag.
claire: Rollout plan suggestion:
Phase 1 (2w): start emitting `X-RW-ErrKind` and `X-RW-ErrID` while leaving current status codes untouched. Backend logs + telemetry populate new fields.
Phase 2 (4w): SDKs read headers and prefer header semantics. Console uses headers to compute badges.
Phase 3 (8w): flip status codes to canonical mapping; announce deprecation, provide compatibility docs.
sam: Ownership: eng-platform owns headers+gateway (I'll take). infra owns telemetry + dashboards (omar?). product/UI owns console mapping and copy (claire). SDKs own runtimes (we'll coordinate).
omar: I'll wire up a Kibana/Events sample showing err_kind breakdown for last 7 days and a low-cardinality err_id store for click-through. Need retention policy decision.
rita: Docs: add a Compatibility guide page for partners that explains header-first migration and shows sample code snippets for common SDKs.
infra-bot: Ticket created: INC-2099 inconsistent-client-signals -> assignees: sam, omar, claire, rita.
sam: Quick example of header-first payloads we should standardize (proto):
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RW-ErrKind: quota_hard
X-RW-ErrID: a1b2c3
Retry-After: 60

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-RW-ErrKind: quota_soft
X-RW-ErrID: d4e5f6
Content-Type: application/json

{"id":"resp_123","choices":[...],"warning":"Results degraded due to high load"}
```
rita: Good concrete example. Also recommend a short `err_code` machine token like `q_soft` for compact telemetry.
claire: UI copy ideas (short + long):
- Short (API): "degraded results: see console"
- Long (Console): "Traffic exceeded preferred thresholds; we served degraded results to maintain latency. Tips: enable caching, lower max_tokens, request quota increase."
sam: Risks: third-party parsers that map status codes to retry behavior will need clear migration guidance. Also caching behavioral differences across SDKs.
omar: Mitigations: publish a migration RFC, examples for curl/node/python, provide a one-month overlap. Also add `X-RW-Retryable: true|false` header for immediate programmatic retry hints.
claire: Action items:
- sam: RFC + header naming PR by end of week.
- omar: telemetry dashboard prototype for err_kind by next Wed.
- rita: compatibility docs + partner email draft by next Tue.
- claire: console badge copy + hover content by next Tue.
- SDK owners: prep header parsing + feature-flagged strict-mode (jess from SDKs pls confirm).
jess: SDKs team acked; we'll start a canary branch and sync with eng-platform next week.
sam: Thanks. If no objections, i'll set up a weekly 30-min sync to run through progress. :thumbsup:
rita: +1
omar: +1
claire: +1
jess: +1
